note: Copy to confluence-spaces.json and fill in your settings.
spaces: space keys appear in the URL — /display/SPACEKEY/Page+Title
min_change_chars: pages with fewer changed characters than this are filtered as trivial (default: 50). Set to 0 to disable.
max_diff_pages: max pages to fetch version diffs for (default: 15). Keeps brief fast.
exclude_title_patterns: regex strings matched against page titles (case-insensitive).
my_context_keywords: your primary product/project names. Used together with skip_if_only_mentions.
skip_if_only_mentions: other products/teams that are noisy for you.
